---
title: "BIKI Valladolid — Histórico"
output: flexdashboard::flex_dashboard
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(crosstalk)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# La columna "barrio" ya viene calculada en el CSV (ver scripts/scrape_biki.R)
hist_data <- read_csv("data/biki_history.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(total_bicis = mecanicas + electricas)

sd <- SharedData$new(hist_data)
```

### Filtros {.sidebar}

```{r}
filter_select("barrio", "Barrio", sd, ~barrio)
filter_select("nombre", "Parada", sd, ~nombre)
```

### Evolución histórica

```{r}
plot_ly(sd, x = ~timestamp, y = ~total_bicis, color = ~nombre,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers") %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Bicis disponibles"), xaxis = list(title = ""))
```
